description:
Two fixtures write into the process working directory, so files leak into worktrees and parallel lanes share one path.
- 00252 creates fz-variadic-open-test.tmp and never deletes it (found as an untracked file in a research worktree).
- 00775 writes 00775_take.tmp at one cwd-relative path that every lane (interp/compiled/jit) uses, so concurrent lanes race on the same file.
Goal: each fixture that touches the filesystem works in a directory of its own (per run, per lane) and leaves nothing behind. Signal: after a full fixture_matrix run, git status in the worktree shows no new files; lanes no longer share a path. Found 2026-11-14 during fz-t93.3 research (H4).
title: Fixtures that touch files use a temporary directory of their own
